summary: The 'StudentProfileDetails' document describes the implementation of a web user control designed to handle student profile details in an ASP.NET environment. It includes functionality for displaying, editing, and managing student profiles using a GridView and FormView interface. The control supports operations like adding, editing, and deleting student details while ensuring user sessions are managed and validations are performed.
purpose: To manage student profile details, including adding, viewing, and editing student information through a web interface.

actors.name: User
actors.description: A person interacting with the student profile details interface.

workflows.name: Managing Student Profile Details
steps: User accesses the student profile details interface.
User can add, edit, or delete student information as needed.
On adding, a new student profile is created with provided details.
On editing, existing profile details are updated.
On deletion, the student profile is removed.
Session management ensures only authorized users can make changes.
Validation ensures data integrity and correctness.

business_rules: Profiles can only be modified by users with appropriate session credentials.
validations: Ensure number fields are formatted correctly.
Ensure profile details are not repeated unnecessarily.
Ensure all form fields are populated correctly before submission.
calculations: Indent labels according to the numbering indent level.
conditions: Show 'no data found' message only if the grid has no rows and the screen is editable.
system_behavior: The system hides or shows certain panels based on the data header state.
A hyperlink is used for web page entries when the profile has a URL.
The screen allows adding, editing, or deleting profiles based on session state.
exceptions: JavaScript errors related to event validation when using an EmptyDataTemplate.
